subject: Choosing from a subset of point characters

messages.author: d8c7417f6230883b
messages.subject: Choosing from a subset of point characters
parts:
Hi,

for a better visualization of my data I´d like point symbols to be
rather from a certain subset of the pch chart (for example 0,3,4)
instead of 15-17 which seems to be ggplots default (at least if my
variable, by which points are mapped has only 3 levels) (
http://wiki.stdout.org/rcookbook/Graphs/Shapes%20and%20line%20types/pch.png
).

Value <- sample ( 1:10, 36, replace = TRUE)
Spec <- rep ( letters[1:4], each = 9)
Variable <- rep ( letters [5:7], each = 3, 4)
Facet <- rep( letters [ 8:10], 12)

DF <- cbind.data.frame (Value, Spec, Variable, Facet)

ggplot ( DF, aes (x = Spec, y = Value)) +
facet_wrap ( ~ Facet) +
geom_point ( aes ( shape = Variable, size = 2, colour = Variable)) +
geom_line ( aes ( group = Variable, linetype = Variable, colour =
Variable)) +
scale_shape(solid=FALSE)

The point is: in my real data points can have the same y value, which
should be visable immediatly. The default point characters combined in
my way lack these properties.

Thanks for your help,

Gunnar

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Choosing from a subset of point characters
parts:
Hi:

Here's one way to do it:

ggplot ( DF, aes (x = Spec, y = Value)) +
facet_wrap ( ~ Facet) +
geom_point ( aes ( shape = Variable, size = 2, colour = Variable)) +
geom_line ( aes ( group = Variable, linetype = Variable, colour =
Variable)) +

scale_shape_manual(breaks = levels(DF$Variable),
values = c(0, 3, 4))

BTW, to get rid of the '2' in the legend, move size = 2 outside the
aes() statement in geom_point(); i.e.,
geom_point ( aes ( shape = Variable, colour = Variable), size = 2)

In this case, the size aesthetic is *set* to a constant value, so
belongs outside aes(). Variables *mapped* to aesthetics belong inside
aes(), and a legend will be drawn for each such aesthetic.

HTH,
Dennis
